explanation: Agaves are succulents, not cacti. Growers wait years for each plant to mature, then cut away the leaves and roast the heart, called the piña.

claims.text: Tequila is distilled from the fermented juice of the blue agave plant (Agave tequilana).
Tequila is not distilled from prickly pear, sugar cane or barley.
Agaves are succulents but not cacti.
Blue agave plants take years to mature; at harvest the leaves are cut away and the heart, called the piña, is cooked.
